summary: Complete automatic standards registration and self-adoption with repository-local path safety

delivery.outcome: Recover the existing authorized ticket through the published fenced allocator, finish additive registration and safe repository-root selection, complete self-adoption and package metadata, and deliver through protected publication before real-repository rollout.
nonGoals: Claim registration alone proves conformance or protected enforcement
Replace existing adopter pins, reports or independent controller storage
Modify foreign repositories without their own admitted ticket and lease
Implement every catalog checker in this slice
Overwrite existing bundled fixes on main or clean unknown work

architecture.decision: Preserve the previous owner's additive registration and bootstrap snapshot. Git discovery selects the active repository/worktree; reject symlink escapes before writes and require explicit bootstrap outside Git. Repo-owned metadata and final documentation remain in the owning checkout; external protected authority state is not relocated. Only the immutable updater changes managed payloads. Integrate existing main changes without reverting them after recovery.
dataChanges: Repository-local additive standard-requirements.json and pinned self-adoption metadata
architecture.rollback: Preserve the pre-adoption content-addressed snapshot and existing committed implementation. Publish a corrective version; never move immutable tags, silently overwrite pins or remove unknown workspace data.

validation.evidence: Preservation, additive registration, idempotence, nested directory, active linked checkout, outside-Git and symlink-escape regressions.
Published immutable self-adoption, native allocator recovery, package governance lifecycle and exact scope validation.
Built artifact canary first; prior Semcod disposable-copy pilot remains read-only evidence, not real-repository rollout or conformance.
